reviews.text:
Absolute Necessity. As a person that has been diagnosed with ADHD Combined Type, I have found that any slight noise can be a distraction to me and cause me to lose my focus on my task at hand, and become fixated on the source of the noise.

Therefore, a good pair of noise cancellation headphones, and this app are absolute necessities for me. My medications and this app are crucial for my ability to focus and concentrate.
Love. Best ever
Great free app. This is the best to have an app that people without a bunch of money to use to get some focus and achieve success
